summary: Maris-Tech Ltd., a Nasdaq-listed Israeli defense-tech foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 7, 2026, announcing its participation in the AUSA 2026 exposition on October 12-14, 2026, at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, D.C., Booth #761. The company will demonstrate edge video and AI solutions for armored vehicles and unmanned platforms. The release also references recent commercial momentum, including a US$10 million multi-year contract and a pilot order. No special-situation transaction, securities offering, or corporate action is disclosed. No deal terms stated.
